notes.lead: Up more at night than usual
notes.text: on 3 of the last 7 nights, between 1 and 4 am. It may be poor sleep or more trips to the bathroom. Worth mentioning to her GP.
today, about 48 minutes more than usual. The heat at home is the likely reason.

bubbles.text: Mum, what did you have for lunch?
A ham sandwich and a cup of tea, love.
